data.narrative:
Bohr Systems is a pre-seed stage Defense & Security company founded by Rohil Gharat (CEO, prior experience at Antler, Founders Inc., and Cisco) and Samarth Kumbla (CTO, Columbia CS '27). The sector peer universe includes 23 Defense & Security companies, of which 2 are public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 are private. Top private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Peer-median valuation proves inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. A search for same-stage and adjacent-stage Defense & Security peers yielded zero matches at the same stage and only one adjacent-stage company—below the three-datapoint minimum required for statistical reliability. Application of all-sector median would introduce material bias given the specialized capital requirements and risk profiles within Defense & Security. Consequently, no triangulated valuation range can be derived from available peer data.

The analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without either: (1) additional pre-seed or early-seed stage peers in Defense & Security meeting similar technical scope and funding environment; or (2) disclosed financials from the identified private comparables. Key uncertainties include the company's product definition, customer traction, and IP differentiation relative to the broader peer set. Further due diligence on these dimensions is prerequisite to valuation.
